`abstract class SelectorNode<V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseSelectorNode<V>`](/reference/controls/baseselectornode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.selector` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SelectorNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/selector/SelectorNode.java)

A drop-down list made of a `field` and one node per option, with the selected option on top and the others in rows under it or above it.

![A closed selector showing its first option; the pointer opens it, picks Second, opens it again and picks First](/captures/catalog-controls-selectornode.webp)

## Description

A skin extends it and gives `field(...)` and `option(value -> node)`.
Each row has the height of the selector; while the list is open, the selector grows to show every option, and the field covers the whole list.
A left press on an option selects it through `change(...)` and closes the list.
Attaching a selector without a field or without an `option` function throws an `IllegalStateException`.

### SelectorNode

`SelectorNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

## Property details

<a id="SelectorNode-property-field"></a>

### field

- `this field(Node field)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getField()` 

**Default:** `null`

The node drawn behind the options, over the selected row while the list is closed and over every row while it is open, with a `zindex` of `-1`; required.

<a id="SelectorNode-property-option"></a>

### option

- `this option(Function<V,Node> option)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `null`

The function that creates the node of an option from its value.
The selector calls it again for every option each time the options change.

The side where the list opens: `DOWN` under the selected row, `UP` above it, near the bottom of the screen.
